   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, June 3, 2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Walters called the meeting to order at 8:33 a.m. The following Board
  Members were present: Craig Walters, Marianne Stark, and George Henderson. Not
  present: Mickey Rehm and Zuhey Espinoza. City Representatives present: Community
  Development Director Eric Scherer, Mayor Tim Hepburn, Council Member Steve
  Johnson, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present: Ken Valmonte, Fang Wang, Roy
  Cannizzo, Roberta Virgin, and Rick Sanders.

2.  CALENDAR

  Annual Protest Hearing – City Council  Monday, June 3rd – 6:30pm
  City Council Meeting - Café Wang Patio  Monday, June 17th – 6:30pm
  University Dinner Crawl  Thursday, August 29th – 4-6pm
  Beer Walk  Tentative Date: Saturday, 9/28 –
  5pm-8:30pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Stark to approve the minutes of the
  May 13, 2024 meeting. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  University of La Verne Dinner Crawl – Cindy Vallejo of the University of La
  Verne announced that the Dinner Crawl event is returning on Thursday, August
  29th. Ms. Vallejo requested the BID provide a band at Mainiero Square.

  It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Mr. Henderson to approve the
  expenditure. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B.  Beer Walk Update – Mia Valdez was not present to report on the Beer Walk
  meeting. More information will be emailed when it becomes available.

  C.  Summer Concerts at Mainiero – Mr. Walters asked if the Board was interested in
  hosting two concerts towards the end of summer.

  Mr. Scherer suggested staggering the dates so that it does not conflict with the
  Concert in the Park series at Heritage Park.
   It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Stark to approve $1,000
  expenditure for two summer concerts to be held July 20th and August 17th at 5pm.
  Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  D.  Cancellation of July 1, 2024 meeting – Mr. Walters stated that the next meeting
  will be cancelled due to lack of business.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  None

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): Mr. Scherer stated that the Gold Line rail grinding is
  scheduled to end this week and construction is on schedule. Mr. Scherer recently
  toured the station platform. The University of La Verne is working on a plan to clean
  up the building visible from the platform. Mayor Hepburn stated that the City is
  working with Gold Line to create a walkway along Arrow Highway and clean up the
  weeds.
  B. University Report (Cindy Vallejo): Ms. Vallejo stated that students begin returning to
  campus next week and move in day is August 17th.
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): None
  D. Chamber Report (Leah Skinner): None
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F. Financial Report: None

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Mr. Cannizzo commented on the patio structure at Café Wang. He stated concerns that
  two of the voting board members are not business owners and the patio is not used
  enough.

  Mayor Hepburn and Mr. Johnson stated that they are present to support and for more
  information regarding the patio. Mr. Scherer stated that the City Council presentation will
  be on June 17th.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:06 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on August 5,
  2024 at 8:30 a.m. at Café Wang – 2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt

OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, August 5,2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Vice-chairperson Henderson called the meeting to order at8.,32 a.m. The following
  Board Members were present: Micky Rehm, Zuhey Espinoza, and George Henderson.
  Not present: Craig Walters and Marianne Stark. City Representatives present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Manager Ken Domer, Public
  Works Supervisor Colin Purdy and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present: Ken
  Valmonte, Fang Wang, Mia Valdez, and Michael Mergil.

2.  CALENDAR

  Summer Music Series  Saturday, August 17th 5:30-
  7:30pm
  University Dinner Crawl  Thursday, August 29th 4-6pm
  Beer Walk  Saturday, September 28th 5-
  8:30pm
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Thursday, October 3l't 2-5pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 23'd 10am-
  4pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 7th 4pm

3.  APPROVAL OF TIIE MINUTES

  It was moved by Ms. Rehm and seconded by Dr. Espinoza to approve the minutes of the
  June 3, 2024 meeting. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSTNESS

  A.  Banner Poles - Mr. Purdy of the Public Works Department explained that the
  banner poles need replacement. Mr. Purdy suggested offering the space to outside
  advertisements for a fee to help pay for the purchase of the new poles.

  Ms. Rehm asked if the BID would have priority on advertising space

  Mr. Scherer stated that if the BID were to contribute money towards the purchase
  of the poles, they would have priority.

  Mr. Purdy stated that the cost is estimated around $75,000 and it willtake 6-7
  months to custom make the poles.

  The board had questions regarding the cost ofadvertising space and the duration.
   Mr. Purdy stated that the cost is to be determined. Mr. Scherer stated that the
  duration would be somewhere between 2-3 weeks at a time.

  Mr. Henderson stated that the board needs to discuss further

  B.  Beer Walk Update - Ms. Yaldez provided an update on the event. The
  participation fee is set for $175 for pouring locations and $75 for food only
  locations.

  Due to the increase in glass prices, it was suggested that plastic cups be used in its
  place. Mr. Mergil stated that the plastic is a nicer heavy duty quality cup. Dr.
  Zuhey stated that the university would be interested in sponsoring the cups.

  The beer tasting ticket price will be $55 and increase to $60 closer to the event.
  The food only ticket will be $35.

  Mr. Mergil stated that several quotes are still out for ice companies, sponsors are
  still needed, and the postage for the postcards has increased. The estimated
  postcard and postage cost is $7,200.

  Mr. Scherer suggested scheduling the next meeting soon to finalize the event
  details.

5.  CONTINUED BUSTNESS

  A.  University of La Verne Dinner Crawl - Ms. Vallejo stated that she is still
  accepting participants. Offerings include food and discounts from participating
  stores,

  Mr. Scherer stated that the band is secured and being provided by the BID.

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): Mr. Scherer stated that there is a City Council meeting
  tonight and the August 19th meeting is cancelled. The next meeting will be held on
  Tuesday, September 3'd. The review will begin tomorrow for the BID RFP consultant
  submissions. There will be a meeting with the BID Board to discuss the qualifications
  and pay. He also announced that the annual street improvements will start soon. The
  Brethren lot will be renovated as part of the project.

  Mr. Domer stated that the outdoor dining policy will be updated with the direction of
  the City Council. He anticipates that it will take at least 6 months to update the policy
  He also stated that the current patio policy was extended through June 30, 2025. The
  new policy will be a public process with input from all'
   Mr. Scherer requested to schedule a meeting with sub-committee to discuss RFP
  proposals before further discussion at the next regular meeting to be held September
  gth.

  It was moved by Ms. Rehm and seconded by Dr. Espinoza to create a sub-committee
  to review the RFP proposals. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): The university is hosting a street fair on
  September l4m. The event willconsist of a street closure on 3'd Street and it's
  anticipated to have 60 vendors. Dr. Espinoza stated that the street fair will welcome
  the high school to college transition for individuals that identify as Hispanic.

  Dr. Zuhey stated that the university hosted its first community meeting, and a
  community event page was created for full transparency. She also announced that
  ULV President Dr. Pardis Mahdavi stepped down. They are currently in the process
  of hiring a new President in the next two weeks.

  Ms. Vallejo announced that Homecoming is scheduled for October I l-l3th with
  events beginning October 7th.

  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm needs Beer Walk information to begin
  marketing the event.

  D. Chamber Report (Leah Skinner): None

  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm stated that the Association is
  searching for someone to manage social media.

  F. Financial Report: None
7,  PUBLIC CO MMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  None

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at9.21a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on September 9,
  2024 at 8:30 a.m. at Caf6 Wang -2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  submitted.

  Natalie
